headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin that uses Sense Solar monitoring to optimize Tesla EV charging based on solar production.
footerDisplay: For help and documentation, please visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/irajczi/homebridge-sense-tesla-ev-optimization).

senseEmail.title: Sense Account Email
senseEmail.description: The email address associated with your Sense Energy Monitor account.

sensePassword.title: Sense Account Password
sensePassword.description: The password for your Sense Energy Monitor account.

fleetClientId.title: Tesla Fleet API Client ID
fleetClientId.description: The client ID (UUID) from your registered application at developer.tesla.com.

fleetApiKey.title: Tesla Fleet API Client Secret
fleetApiKey.description: The client secret from your registered application at developer.tesla.com.

teslaEmail.title: Tesla Account Email (optional)
teslaEmail.description: Optional. The email address associated with your Tesla account.

vehicleVIN.title: Vehicle VIN (optional)
vehicleVIN.description: The VIN of the Tesla vehicle to control. If omitted, the first vehicle on the account will be used.

minimumChargeAmps.title: Minimum Charge Amps
minimumChargeAmps.description: The minimum charging current (in amps). The session stops when surplus drops below this if stop_when_insufficient is true.

maximumChargeAmps.title: Maximum Charge Amps
maximumChargeAmps.description: The maximum charging current (in amps) to allow.

pollingIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to read Sense and adjust the charging rate.

stopWhenInsufficient.title: Stop charging when solar is insufficient
stopWhenInsufficient.description: If true, stops the charging session when surplus drops below the minimum amps. If false, keeps charging at minimum amps.

autoOffAfterNoSolarMinutes.title: Auto-off after no solar (minutes)
autoOffAfterNoSolarMinutes.description: Stop charging automatically after this many minutes with no solar production. Leave blank to disable.
